findings.body: The spec requires a fixed module list, while the supplied COLLECTOR contract requires discovering modules with `pkgutil` without a fixed list. Following this spec would require editing shared code whenever a command introduces a new module, contradicting the acceptance criterion at lines 61–62. Update this requirement and the corresponding read-note disposition to match the agreed discovery contract.
findings.title: Align command discovery with the agreed pkgutil contract

findings.body: The spec assigns the CI workflow to the init module and the Forge skill to a skill module. The supplied SHIPS contract instead assigns these to `prcheck.py` and `story.py`, respectively, and excludes `init.py` from that task's scope. Reconcile these ownership requirements so implementation can follow the confirmed spec within the agreed task boundaries.
